name: Phishing Email & Credential Harvest Attack
description: A simulated threat actor sends spear-phishing emails containing malicious attachments or credential harvesting links to corporate staff.

controls.name: Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) across all accounts
Monthly Phishing Simulations & Employee Security Drills
Deploy One-Click Phishing Report Button & Automated Email Triage

remediation: Mandate FIDO2/Hardware MFA or Authenticator App push notifications for all users.
Conduct targeted awareness re-training for employees failing phishing drills.
Implement DMARC, DKIM, and SPF policies to block spoofed email domains.

name: Unpatched Remote Desktop (RDP) Exploitation
description: A simulated threat actor scans public internet IP ranges for exposed, unpatched RDP ports and attempts automated brute-force access.

controls.name: Enforce 48-Hour Patch Management SLA for Critical Vulnerabilities
Micro-segment RDP Access behind Zero Trust / VPN with MFA
Deploy Centralized EDR Telemetry & Behavioral Threat Detection

remediation: Disable direct internet-facing RDP ports and mandate Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA).
Automate vulnerability scanning and patch critical CVEs within 48 hours.
Isolate server management networks from general workstation subnets.

name: Double Extortion Ransomware via Lateral Movement
description: A simulated adversary gains initial foothold and attempts to exfiltrate sensitive data while seeking domain admin credentials.

controls.name: Air-gap & Immutable Offline Backups with Immutable Storage Locks
Activated Incident Response Playbook & Pre-retained Forensic Experts
Centralized 24/7 SIEM/SOC Monitoring & Immediate Isolation Triggers

remediation: Ensure offline backup copies are physically or logically separated from Active Directory domain.
Conduct quarterly ransomware incident response tabletop exercises with executive leadership.
Implement Privileged Access Management (PAM) with temporary Just-In-Time session limits.
